# World Encyclopedia

## Biomes

| Biome | Rarity | Resources | Threat |
|-------|--------|----------|-------|
| Forest | common | wood, herbs | low |
| Mountain | uncommon | stone, ore | medium |
| Desert | rare | spices, relics | high |
| Ocean | rare | fish, pearls | medium |
| Swamp | uncommon | herbs, bugs | medium |
| Tundra | rare | fur, ice | high |
| Volcanic | legendary | obsidian, fire | extreme |

## Locations

### Town Structure

- Town Hall (quintessential)
- Inn (social hub)
- Shop (3-5 merchants)
- Temple (blessings)
- Blacksmith (repairs)
- Quest Board

### Wilderness POIs

- Ancient ruins > lore + loot
- Monster camps > combat + rewards
- Hidden caches > secrets
- Portals > fast travel

## World Events

| Type | Trigger | Duration |
|------|---------|----------|
| Political | random/player | 24h |
| Social | NPC decisions | 12h |
| Environmental | time | 6h |
| Personal | player action | immediate |

## Weather System

- Clear: 50%
- Rain: 25%
- Storm: 15%
- Snow: 7%
- Fog: 3%

## Fast Travel

- Discovered locations only
- 5 gold base + distance
- Nocombat zones only
